description: This file defines a class PrometheusServicesLogger used for integrating Prometheus metrics with the litellm services. It initializes metrics, provides methods to create, update, and log metrics related to litellm services, ensuring monitoring of requests, latencies, and errors via Prometheus.

classes.name: PrometheusServicesLogger
classes.description: A class to handle Prometheus metrics logging for litellm services, including creation of histograms, counters, gauges, and hooks for logging service success and failure events.
